title: Scripted install: first-run and invite write the invitation to a new owner-only file
spec: `first-run ... --invitation-file <new-file>` and `invite <data> <email> --invitation-file <new-file>` run without a terminal and write the invitation (link, server, code, root fingerprint) to a new file created with create_new and mode 0600; the terminal gets only a 'written to' line. The file is checked before anything is created: an existing path or a missing folder is refused and no server is created. Without a terminal and without the flag, both refuse and name the flag.
